note: Gold answers and accept_patterns are for grading only. build_prompt() sends the reader the prose and the question text, nothing else.

questions.question: What is the main empirical finding of this section?
questions.gold: ValuePrism contains a real context-dependent relation task: the same consideration receives both labels in different situations.

questions.question: On which axes must a strict-test row be held out?
questions.gold: Both: its situation must be unseen in training and its consideration cluster must be unseen in training.

questions.question: What comparison shows that familiar consideration wording is a shortcut?
questions.gold: Deliberately exposing held-out consideration wording improved a text-only predictor by 7.29 percentage points, while exposing familiar situations changed little.

questions.question: What does the strict grouping cost?
questions.gold: A stricter semantic filter left only 1,865 within-situation comparisons, and the next automatic filter collapsed to 23.
